The assigned proof uses only the correct expansion, normalization and purity parts of F1, not the erroneous spectral phrase, so no deduction or public claim is lost. reviews.reason: Checked the current Statement, all five proof steps, exact F1-F6 suppliers, owning contract and page. F1 now identifies s_r as square roots of eigenvalues of the positive endomorphism CC*:H_0 -> H_0, with C defined on the conjugate factor support. Its tensor identity now has x in H and y in K. The summable squared coefficients and rank-one trace norm give convergent reduction series; bounded rank-one pairings determine both reductions with the first-linear convention. The Schmidt purity formula proves the purity/product equivalences, equality rho=rho_A tensor rho_B forces s_r^2=s_r^4, and the inspected pure-state separability proof supplies the strict overlap and trace-norm witness. Unit norm excludes empty Schmidt support; finite and countably infinite support are covered. Countable Choice suffices for these deductions, with inherited AC retained for the physical reading. Statement and physical scope are byte-for-byte unchanged. This is adjudicator review of the repaired carrier, not independent review of this repair.
